_note: Every error code the execution layer can return: retryable = re-sending the SAME call can succeed (a transient condition); hint = the next step for the model. tests/test_error_registry.py keeps this in step with the C# sources.

ACTIVATE_FAILED.hint: SolidWorks could not activate that document; it may have been closed.

ADD_MATE_FAILED.hint: The mate was rejected; check the entity names/types, alignment and that the mate is not over-defining.

ANALYSIS_FAILED.hint: The analysis could not be completed; check the document type and that it holds a solid body.

AXIS_NOT_FOUND.hint: The axis could not be found; check its name or define it with add_reference_geometry.

BATCH_EXPORT_FAILED.hint: One or more formats failed; run export_document for each format to see which.

BEND_FLIP_FAILED.hint: The bend could not be flipped; rebuild the bend with the opposite flip setting.

BODY_COPY_FAILED.hint: The body could not be copied.

BODY_NOT_FOUND.hint: No solid body at that index; analyze_model('bodies') lists them.

CALLOUT_FAILED.hint: The hole callout could not be added; place px/py on the hole's circular edge.

COM_ATTACH_FAILED.hint: SolidWorks is not reachable. Call ensure_ready, then retry.

COM_ERROR.hint: SolidWorks rejected the call. Check for a modal dialog, call verify_state, then retry once; if it repeats, change the inputs.

DIMENSION_CREATION_FAILED.hint: The dimension could not be added; check the pick points lie on the geometry.

DIMENSION_NOT_FOUND.hint: No dimension has that name; analyze_model('features') lists driving dimensions.

DIRECTION_NOT_FOUND.hint: The direction reference could not be resolved.

DOCUMENT_CAST_FAILED.hint: The active document is not the expected kind for this operation.

DOCUMENT_CREATION_FAILED.hint: SolidWorks could not create the document; check the template path (open_new_part template_path) and call ensure_ready.

DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND.hint: No open document has that title. verify_state lists the active one; open it first.

EDGE_NOT_FOUND.hint: No edge matched. Use analyze_model('edges', near=...) and pass edge_indices, or an edge midpoint.

ENTITY_NOT_FOUND.hint: No entity matched; check the name/type and that the document holds it.

EXPORT_FAILED.hint: The export failed; check the format and that the target folder is writable and the file is not open elsewhere.

EXTRUSION_FAILED.hint: The extrusion produced no feature: check the profile is closed, the depth > 0 and the direction (reverse) is on the material side.

FACE_NOT_FOUND.hint: No face matched. Use analyze_model('faces') and pass its index, or a point that lies on the face.

FEATURE_CREATION_FAILED.hint: SolidWorks created no feature; check the profile is closed/valid and the end condition makes sense.

FEATURE_NOT_FOUND.hint: No feature has that name; analyze_model('features') lists them (names may be localized).

FILE_NOT_FOUND.hint: The file path does not exist on the PC running SolidWorks. Check the path and spelling.

FLAT_PATTERN_FAILED.hint: The flat pattern could not be created; check the sheet-metal body is valid.

FLAT_PATTERN_VIEW_FAILED.hint: The flat-pattern view could not be created; the part must be sheet metal with a flat pattern.

HOLE_WIZARD_FAILED.hint: Hole Wizard created no hole; check the face reference, diameter and depth.

HOLE_WIZARD_FEATURE_ERROR.hint: Hole Wizard produced a feature in error; see feature_errors, adjust diameter/depth/position.

INSERT_FAILED.hint: The component could not be inserted; check the file path and that it is a part/assembly.

INVALID_PARAMETER.hint: A parameter value is not accepted; the message says which and why.

INVALID_STATE_VERSION.hint: The adapter resyncs and retries this automatically; if you still see it, call verify_state and retry.

MATERIAL_NOT_FOUND.hint: That material is not in the library; the name must match the SolidWorks Materials database exactly.

MISSING_PARAMETER.hint: A required parameter is missing or out of range; the message names it. Fix the call, do not repeat it.

MODEL_NOT_FOUND.hint: The referenced model file could not be found; check the path.

NOT_A_DRAWING.hint: The active document is not a drawing. create_drawing, or activate the drawing.

NO_ACTIVE_DOCUMENT.hint: No document is open. open_new_part / open_document / create_drawing first.

OPEN_FAILED.hint: SolidWorks could not open the file (corrupt, wrong version, or locked). Try STEP/DXF import or another copy.

PATTERN_FAILED.hint: The pattern produced no instances; check the seed feature, spacing/angle and count.

PLANE_NOT_FOUND.hint: No plane has that name (it may be localized); use Front/Top/Right Plane names as listed by analyze_model.

POINT_NOT_ON_FACE.hint: The point does not lie on the selected face; take a point from analyze_model('faces').

PROFILE_NOT_FOUND.hint: The profile sketch was not found; create it and keep it as the previous sketch.

REFERENCE_GEOMETRY_FAILED.hint: The reference plane/axis could not be created; check the referenced entities.

RIB_FAILED.hint: The rib produced no feature: the profile must be open geometry whose extension meets existing walls.

SAVE_FAILED.hint: The file could not be saved (read-only, invalid name, or locked). Choose another path with save_document.

SECTION_LINE_FAILED.hint: The section line could not be created; place it across the parent view.

SECTION_VIEW_FAILED.hint: The section view failed; check the cut line position on the parent view.

SEGMENT_NOT_FOUND.hint: No sketch segment matched the given point.

SELECTION_FAILED.hint: SolidWorks could not select the target; check names/coordinates and that nothing else is selected.

SHEET_METAL_FAILED.hint: The sheet-metal feature failed; check thickness, the edge/face reference and that the part is a sheet-metal body.

SKETCH_ALREADY_ACTIVE.hint: A sketch is already open; finish it (the feature tools exit it) before creating another.

SKETCH_CREATION_FAILED.hint: The sketch could not be created; check the plane/face reference.

SKETCH_EDIT_FAILED.hint: The sketch could not be opened for editing.

SKETCH_NOT_ACTIVE.hint: A sketch must be active first: create_sketch (or edit_sketch), add geometry, then run this tool.

SKETCH_NOT_FOUND.hint: No sketch has that name; analyze_model('features') lists them.

TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND.hint: The template file does not exist. Omit template_path to use the default, or pass a valid .prtdot/.asmdot/.drwdot path.

TOOL_TIMEOUT.hint: The operation may still be running inside SolidWorks. Do NOT re-run it: call verify_state, look for a modal dialog in SolidWorks, then continue.

TRANSFORM_FAILED.hint: The component transform could not be applied.

UNEXPECTED_ERROR.hint: An unhandled error inside the execution layer. Check execution.log; call verify_state before retrying.

UNKNOWN_TOOL.hint: The execution layer does not know this tool; the adapter and the execution exe are out of sync. Rebuild/restart the execution server.

UNSUPPORTED_ANALYSIS_TYPE.hint: analysis_type is not one of the supported values; see analyze_model.

UNSUPPORTED_CONSTRAINT_TYPE.hint: constraint_type is not supported; see add_sketch_constraint.

UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE_TYPE.hint: feature_type is not supported by this tool.

UNSUPPORTED_GEOMETRY_TYPE.hint: That geometry type is not supported by this tool.

UNSUPPORTED_MATE_TYPE.hint: mate_type is not supported; see add_mate.

UNSUPPORTED_VIEW_TYPE.hint: view type is not supported; see add_drawing_view.

VERTEX_NOT_FOUND.hint: No vertex matched the given point.

VIEW_CREATION_FAILED.hint: The drawing view could not be created; the drawing needs a model to reference.

WRONG_DOCUMENT_TYPE.hint: This tool needs a different document type (part, assembly or drawing). activate_document or open the right one.

WRONG_FEATURE_TYPE.hint: That feature is not of the type this operation needs; analyze_model('features') lists types.
